paragraphs.text: Clement is a legendary frogfolk druid from Bloomburrow .

Clement is a notable Frogfolk druid from Bloomburrow . Clement's skin is a mottled green, and he wears simple robes that drape loosely over his form. Clement's primary tool and symbol of his magical prowess is a gnarled staff, carved from ancient driftwood and imbued with the elemental energies of water.

Clement has a reputation to uphold as the safest adventurer in Valley . A keen master of the elements hides beneath the charmingly worried demeanor. At his parties, you can rest assured that you'll be setting out in perfect weather, with little to no danger, and a respectable reward. When danger does strike, Clement will be ready with provisions, directions, and destruction. And if that wasn't enough, he's said to cook some of Valley's best seedloaf, if you can get past the slimy coating. He says it's good for digestion; his parties would say it's hard to digest.
